name: Side Plank Hip Dip
cues: Set up in a forearm side plank with your feet stacked
Lower your hip toward the floor without touching it
Drive the hip up until your body is straight
Finish the reps on one side, then switch

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3b 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. minor: Pelvis drops 13 cm (ty 0.428 to 0.297) through lumbar 16 and thorax 10 deg side bend, with slow lowering and a quick drive.
